segments.text:
V. 7.
He ſpake a parable—The enſuing Diſcourſe is ſo termed, becauſe ſeveral Parts are not to be underſtood literally. The general Scope of it is, not only at a Marriage-Feaſt, but on every Occaſion, He that exalteth himſelf ſhall be abaſed, and he that abaſeth himſelf ſhall be exalted.
